Load Data

df <- read_excel("../03_Data/Japan_merged_2024.xlsx")
New names:
• `` -> `...1`
Japan_full <- df %>% 
  select(headline, abstract, Merged, section, query_date)
Japan_full$contains_trump <- ifelse(grepl("Trump", Japan_full$Merged), 1, 0)
table(Japan_full$contains_trump)

   0    1 
1679  133

Pre-processing

Japan_full$Merged <- gsub("[‘’´`]", "'", Japan_full$Merged)  #Turn all
Japan_full$Merged<- gsub("'", "", Japan_full$Merged) 

data_tokens <- tokens(
    Japan_full$Merged,
    remove_numbers = TRUE,
    remove_punct = TRUE,
    remove_symbols = TRUE,
    remove_separators = TRUE,
    remove_url = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tokens_tolower() %>%
  tokens_remove(
    c(stopwords("english"),
      "briefing",'u.s','monday','tuesday','wednesday', "trump’s",
      "biden's",'Thursday','Frida','Saturday','can','year','like'
    )
  ) %>%
  tokens_select(min_nchar = 2)
#data_dfm <- dfm(data_tokens) %>%
#              dfm_trim(min_termfreq = 2, min_docfreq = 2)
data_dfm <- dfm(data_tokens)
keyATM_docs <- keyATM_read(texts = data_dfm)

Keyword Selection

keywords <- list(
  Entertainment = c('show', 'movies','shogun', 'art', 'tv', 'fashion'), 
  #Added shogun artists and tv
  Election  = c('election', 'vote'),
  Economy = c('economy', 'bill','market', 'stock'),
  Foreign_Policy = c('putin','ukraine', 'iran','israel','gaza'),
  Olympics = c('olympics', 'tracking'),
  Technology = c('a.i', 'tech'),
  Trade = c('trade', 'tariffs')
)
key_viz <- visualize_keywords(docs = keyATM_docs, keywords = keywords)
key_viz
#ggsave("Japan_keyword_dis.png")
keywords <- list(
  APAC = c('china','taiwan', 'korea'),
  US_Politics = c('trump','republican','vance','democrats','biden','kamala','harris')
)
key_viz <- visualize_keywords(docs = keyATM_docs, keywords = keywords)
key_viz
#ggsave("Japan_politics_dis.png")
keywords_combined <- list(
  APAC = c('china','taiwan', 'korea'),
  Entertainment = c('show', 'movies','shogun', 'art', 'tv', 'fashion'), 
  #Added shogun artists and tv
  Election  = c('election', 'vote'),
  Economy = c('economy', 'bill','market', 'stock'),
  Foreign_Policy = c('putin','ukraine', 'iran','israel','gaza'),
  Olympics = c('olympics', 'tracking'),
  Technology = c('a.i', 'tech'),
  Trade = c('trade', 'tariffs'),
  US_Politics = c('trump','republican','vance','democrats','biden', 'kamala','harris')
)
#If keyword all included then there should be no error
key_viz <- visualize_keywords(docs = keyATM_docs, keywords = keywords_combined)
#key_viz

KeyATM

#default is 1500
my_options <- list(
  seed          = 250,
  iterations    = 1000)

key_model <- keyATM(
  docs      = keyATM_docs, # text input
  no_keyword_topics = 4, 
  keywords  = keywords_combined, # keywords
  model     = "base",     
  options   = my_options,  #       
)

Topic Distribution

topic_dis <- values_fig(plot_pi(key_model))
ℹ Plotting pi from the final MCMC draw. Please set `store_pi` to `TRUE` if you want to plot pi over iterations.
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure Topic is ordered by Probability or by original order
topic_dis$Topic <- factor(topic_dis$Topic, levels = topic_dis$Topic)

# Plot
estimated_count_vish <- ggplot(topic_dis, aes(x = Topic, y = Probability)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Probability of Topics (keyATM Estimated)", x = "Topic", y = "Probability") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # Rotate x-axis labels

estimated_count_vish
#ggsave("Japan_keyATM_topic_dis.png")

Covariates

vars_selected <- data.frame(contains_trump = Japan_full$contains_trump)
out <- keyATM(
  docs              = keyATM_docs,
  no_keyword_topics = 5,
  keywords          = keywords_combined,
  model             = "covariates",
  model_settings    = list(
    covariates_data    = vars_selected,
    covariates_formula = ~ contains_trump
  ),
  options = my_options,
)
ℹ Convert covariates data using `model_settings$covariates_formula`.
